info.name: RideLink API
info.description: Source-derived collection covering all 32 controller endpoints across Account, Driver & Vehicle, Ride Management and Fare & Payment. Select RideLink Local environment. All URLs, credentials, identifiers and configurable sample inputs use environment variables; role literals implement the registration DTO. Credentials and internalKey are intentionally blank: enter only local values in Postman. No saved responses or credentials are shipped. Run End-to-End Workflow independently; service folders are an endpoint reference and include mutually exclusive operations such as cancellation. token stores the most recent login/register token; role-specific requests use passengerToken, driverToken or adminToken. Do not run the entire collection as one workflow. Register/login saves role tokens and account IDs. Driver ID is distinct from driverAccountId; rideId is distinct from rideMongoId. No transactionReference lookup endpoint exists; it is saved from payment responses.

item.description: Run this folder alone, in order, with all four services and databases available and compatible JWT settings. Set unused passengerEmail/driverEmail and local passwords (8-72 characters), driverStatus=AVAILABLE and paymentStatus=SUCCESS. Registration and then login are both demonstrated. For existing accounts, skip registration; also skip profile creation if it already exists and first run Get driver by account ID. Re-running registration/profile creation on the same accounts returns 409. Ride Service forwards the caller JWT to downstream services. Completion saves paymentId when available; lookup by ride ID confirms creation. Histories finish the workflow.
